player_field_run.reference_observations: At 30 Hz the most consistent inter-step passage is six frames, some intervals span seven frames. The public clip actor wears a longer, fuller coat and dark boots. Source knees are regularly obscured and source ground forces/joint angles cannot be recovered.

complete_character_1_export.scope: All 4 exported animations; whole character body, boots, cuffs, clothes, faces, joints, bind, skin and original physical topology. Extra threshold 9.9 applies specifically to the player running motion.

scope: These are independent desktop gameplay and asset judgements. Hardware-specific performance, installation, the overall level, and exact inference of occluded source joints are outside these ratings.
